DECLARE @DATETOPROCESS DATE
SET @DATETOPROCESS  = '2024-01-08';

TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_SELECT_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_SELECT_SRC
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
                FILE_NAME,
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)


SELECT 
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
                FILE_NAME,
				1 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				0 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO]
            WHERE H = 'D';


INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_SELECT_SRC
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG, 
				JTAR_FLG 
)
			SELECT 				
                CC.BR_CD,
                CC.SUB_BR_CD,
                CC.BASE_NO,
                CC.ACC_NO,
                CC.PORTFOLIO_NO,
                CC.PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                CC.MAKER_ID,
                CC.MAKER_DATE,
                CC.AUTH_ID,
                CC.AUTH_DATE,
                CC.STATUS,
                CC.REMARKS,
                CC.DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                CC.PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                CC.VERSION,
                CC.PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                CC.MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                CC.RM_ID,
                CC.PROD_CODE,
                CC.PF_DESCRIPTION,
                CC.SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                CC.GARNISHMENT,
                CC.GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                CC.REVIEW_DATE,
                CC.RISK_PROFILE,
                CC.EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
                CC.FILE_NAME,
		        0 AS JSRC_FLG, 
				1 AS JTAR_FLG 
			FROM EDS.TRU_PORTFOLIO CC
            JOIN [d360].[STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO] B
            ON CC.PORTFOLIO_NO  = B.PORTFOLIO_NO 
            AND CC.BASE_NO  = B.BASE_NO 
            AND CC.ACC_NO  = B.ACC_NO 
			WHERE CC.ISLATEST = '1';


TRUNCATE TABLE d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_GROUP_SRC;

INSERT INTO d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_GROUP_SRC
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
                FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT, 
				FILE_DATE
)

select 
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
				FILE_NAME, 
				JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				JTAR_FLG_CNT,
				CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE) FILE_DATE
from 
(
	SELECT 				
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
				MAX(FILE_NAME) FILE_NAME, 
				SUM(JSRC_FLG) AS JSRC_FLG_CNT, 
				SUM(JTAR_FLG) AS JTAR_FLG_CNT
	FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_SELECT_SRC
	GROUP BY 					
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO
	HAVING ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) > 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 0 ) OR ( SUM(JSRC_FLG) = 0 AND SUM(JTAR_FLG) = 1) 
) AS TEMP


DECLARE @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY AS DATE
SELECT @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY = PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY FROM EDS.DATE_DIM 
WHERE FULLDATE = @DATETOPROCESS;	


UPDATE A
SET
SCD_END_DATE = @PREVIOUS_BUSINESS_DAY
, ISLATEST = 0
FROM EDS.TRU_PORTFOLIO A 
INNER JOIN d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_GROUP_SRC B ON
COALESCE(A.PORTFOLIO_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.PORTFOLIO_NO,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.BASE_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.BASE_NO,'-1')
AND COALESCE(A.ACC_NO,'-1') = COALESCE(B.ACC_NO,'-1')
AND A.ISLATEST = 1
AND B.JTAR_FLG_CNT = 1


INSERT INTO EDS.TRU_PORTFOLIO
(
                BR_CD,
                SUB_BR_CD,
                BASE_NO,
                ACC_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NO,
                PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                MAKER_ID,
                MAKER_DATE,
                AUTH_ID,
                AUTH_DATE,
                STATUS,
                REMARKS,
                DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                VERSION,
                PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                RM_ID,
                PROD_CODE,
                PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                GARNISHMENT,
                GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                REVIEW_DATE,
                RISK_PROFILE,
                EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
				SCD_START_DATE, 
				SCD_END_DATE, 
				ISACTIVE, 
				ISLATEST, 
				BNK_CODE, 
				SOURCE_CODE, 
				FILE_NAME, 
				insert_dttm
)
SELECT
                SRC.BR_CD,
                SRC.SUB_BR_CD,
                SRC.BASE_NO,
                SRC.ACC_NO,
                SRC.PORTFOLIO_NO,
                SRC.PORTFOLIO_NAME,
                SRC.MAKER_ID,
                SRC.MAKER_DATE,
                SRC.AUTH_ID,
                SRC.AUTH_DATE,
                SRC.STATUS,
                SRC.REMARKS,
                SRC.DEFAULT_PORTFOLIO,
                SRC.PORTFOLIO_TYPE,
                SRC.VERSION,
                SRC.PORTFOLIO_CATEGORY,
                SRC.MODEL_PORTFOLIO,
                SRC.RM_ID,
                SRC.PROD_CODE,
                SRC.PF_DESCRIPTION,
                SRC.SUBSCRIPTION_ID,
                SRC.GARNISHMENT,
                SRC.GARNISHMENT_AMT,
                SRC.REVIEW_DATE,
                SRC.RISK_PROFILE,
                SRC.EXT_PORTFOLIO_NO,
				@DATETOPROCESS,
				'9999-12-31',
				1,
				1,
				LEFT(SRC.FILE_NAME,5),
				'TRU',
				SRC.FILE_NAME,
				CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime)
FROM d360.STG_EDS_TRU_PORTFOLIO_GROUP_SRC SRC
WHERE JSRC_FLG_CNT > 0
